scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner comes to a bank branch for the first time to start opening an account. They do not have permanent registration, so the first hurdle is whether the branch can help today, what identification is acceptable, and whether another step is required before the application.
Learner: Customer. Partner: Bank employee.
Not in this scene: personal details for the application form, account features, fees, cards, online banking, final decision on opening the account.
must_say: say that you want to open an account — slot: the account type
give your name — slot: the full name
say what documents you have — slot: the document
answer whether you have an address in the country — slot: the address status
ask what document is needed — slot: the purpose
ask whether an appointment is necessary — slot: none
ask where to wait — slot: none
must_understand: asks what you need today
asks for your name and identification
asks whether you have a local address
says which documents are needed for account opening
tells you whether you can do it now or need an appointment

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner is now speaking with the bank adviser who handles account opening. This is the key interaction because the question of registration or temporary address is decided here, along with whether the bank can accept the application and which basic account conditions apply.
Learner: Customer. Partner: Bank adviser.
Not in this scene: greeting at the front desk, asking where to wait, basic document check before the appointment.
must_say: say why you need the account — slot: the purpose
answer what your address situation is — slot: the address status
answer whether you work or study — slot: the status
ask whether a temporary address is acceptable — slot: the address type
ask which account is best for you — slot: the need
ask about the monthly fee — slot: the account
ask when the card will arrive — slot: the thing (the card, the PIN)
confirm you understand the next step — slot: the next step
must_understand: asks why you want to open the account
asks about your address and work or study status
explains whether a temporary address is accepted
offers one or two account options with a fee
tells you what happens next with the card or confirmation
